gates.reference: second-order consistency of the element (orders below the round-off floor are reported as null, not fitted)

gates.quantity: min tip-deflection error of the locking element (thin strip, t/L = 0.01)
gates.reference: shear locking must be visible (negative control)

gates.quantity: max energy error of the locking element on the patch
gates.reference: shear locking must be visible (negative control)

gates.quantity: observed slope of log(strain-energy error) vs log(h/t), distorted patch, fully integrated 2x2 shear, n=4, t/L = 1 .. 0.05
gates.reference: the spurious transverse-shear energy of the bilinear interpolant scales as (h/t)^2, so a locking element must show slope 2 (a negative control on the law, not on one marginal number); threshold 1.5 = the observed-order floor

gates.quantity: e(h/t=5) / e(h/t=0.25) of the energy error, distorted patch, fully integrated shear, n=4
gates.reference: the (h/t)^2 law predicts 20^2 = 400 over this ladder; a factor 4 slack (>= 100) is required. The round-2 single-point control read 2.1 % against a 2 % threshold (a 5 % margin) at h/t = 0.25, i.e. in the thick-plate regime where locking is weakest by construction

gates.quantity: max strain-energy error of MITC4 over both mesh families and both meshes at t/L = 0.05 (h/t = 5)
gates.reference: assumed transverse-shear strain: the element must stay shear-free in the thin limit, where the locking element is ~558 % off

gates.quantity: max strain-energy error of SRI on the AFFINE patch at t/L = 0.05, both meshes
gates.reference: on an affine mesh the SRI element passes the patch test at every thickness, so distortion -- not thickness -- is the trigger of the degradation measured on the distorted family

gates.quantity: |observed slope - 2| of the SRI energy error vs h/t, distorted patch, n=4
gates.reference: mechanism identification: the SRI degradation must follow the same (h/t)^2 locking law (an implementation error would not reproduce the exponent). SRI reduces the constant ~21x but does not remove the thin-plate limitation on distorted meshes

gates.quantity: max |K_ff u_f + K_fc u_c| over all patch cases
gates.reference: discrete equilibrium
